theorem Q.FullSourceCutoff.both_tests_full_source_trace_limit.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [inst_3 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [inst_4 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [inst_5 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_6 : SFinite mu] [inst_7 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] (a l r s : ℝ)
  (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi) (M : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) (u v : Fin 2 → ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
  (∀ (q : Fin 2), Summable fun j => ‖u q j‖ * ‖v q j‖) →
    (∀ (q : Fin 2) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
        HasSum (fun j => ⟪u q j, F⟫_ℂ • v q j)
          ((PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯)
            (M F))) →
      ∀ (q : Fin 2),
        have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
        let E := Q.FullSourceCutoff.fullFiniteSpan K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
        have S := (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection;
        have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun T =>
            Masullo.TraceClass.trace (A.comp M) -
              ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) (A.comp M) x x ∂mu)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((1 - S).comp (A.comp M)))) :=
